reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in your DM and told them to send Thursday's truck to **Dock 27**.

That comes from my notes: Marcus told me in a DM on Oct 14 that Dock 27 is now the dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Driftwood project. That earlier message doesn't show up in the DM history I can read, so I asked them to let me know if anything has changed. I also have dock notes for Ilse and Dana, but those are private to them, so I left them out.
